reviews_5s:
Works great, not flimsyThis is one of the best purchases I've made on Amazon. I use it almost every day, at least once. It's so easy to hang up and so much less bulky than the old style graters that stand up nicely but are awkward to deal with otherwise.Works as advertisedExactly as presented and arrived quicklyThis is exactly what I wanted. It is the perfect size and has the nonslip handles at each end. Really good deal for the price. Would buy again.Very nice grater. Not too big, not too small. Very handy, I don’t have to pull out my big grater, I use this one now.I got this grater to shred tofu, and it’s perfect! The holes are thick, so be warned if you want a finer shred, but I also love thick shredded cheese.

I specifically wanted a grater that laid flat to fit in our random kitchen tools drawer, and the handle provides a great non-slip grip, which is perfect for my smaller hands. I’ve only ever had the big, bulky six-sided grater, and I hated it. This one is ideal for easy storage and handling. It’s super easy to clean, which is a huge plus for me. I’ve used it a bunch already, and it still looks like new. I’m really impressed with how sturdy it feels too. Overall, I couldn’t be happier with this grater—it’s everything I needed and more!very simple and practical, easy to clean.Sturdy sharp and works wellworks like a charm well made product
reviews_1s:
As a chef, we say "you'll never cut yourself with a sharp knife" this holds true for a grater as well.
Dull and jenky this grater shoots jagged bits (not shreds as it is meant to be- but chunky bits of veg) all over the kitchen because you have to jam the carrot so hard to get it to shred. Softer veg like zucchini is a bit easier but for hard root veg this thing is dangerous for slippage and ultimately taking a chunk out of the finger. Yes that happened. Horrible. Bought an OXO Box grater to replace this piece of junkSo the first one of these I got was great, worked flawlessly, and never had an issue.

Unfortunately the second one I picked up is completely different in quality. The grating surface isn't actually fixed to the bars on the outside, meaning that it slips up and down without issue. In addition, the grating surface is wider than the bars will support, meaning that it will "pop" in and out while grating.

At first I thought this was just a defective unit so I had it exchanged, and the new unit is just as bad, so clearly at some point recently they changed their production methods and ruined it.Horrible. It is very flimsy and when you press a block of cheese down to grate, it bends. I had one that looks just like this one, but it was built solid and it never bent or flexed.Not worth it.I bought TWO of these because it looked like such a good deal. I'm a cook and expect my tools to actually be usable. The very first time I used one--simply to grate cheddar cheese-- the metal folded and bent. The grating surface is sharp, but so thin it can't hold up to a hard cheese. With average pressure the plate slid down the side rails to the bottom. It's just flimsy and cheap.

I thew it away, because the folding metal made it useless. I pulled out the other one, hoping it was a fluke. Nope. Both of them were useless. Spend a little more on something that will last and not bend or break immediately.The metal teeth went flat after first use. Cheep flexible metal.Trying to shred potatoes the plate shifted on the handle and then the plate bowed. I threw it in the trashcan before I got more frustrated.Flimsy and cheap. Middle portion does not stay in place.I purchased this grater and went to use it. While using it to shread some cheese I felt something sharp on the palm of my hand and after further inspection of the grater it had a piece of metal sticking out. Good thing I wasn't pressing down hard because I would of surely cut my hand. If you guys buy this kind of grater please make sure you check it to make sure no pieces of metal are sticking out so it won't cause a cut on your hand.I purchased this grater because it was stainless steel and a single flat panel that would be easier to clean than the box style of graters.

Really disappointed that it couldn't cleanly grate a potato for hash browns. It could barely grate cheese ...phooie!

I suppose I could sharpen it with my chain saw file, but this shouldn't be necessary.
